notes:
Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.02.1:

- Customer Connector now parses connector.json / connector-secrets.json reliably on every host: the .exe tolerates UTF-8 BOM and UTF-16 encodings and silently normalises “smart quotes”, non-breaking spaces and zero-width characters that get introduced when the bundle is copied through email, Teams or a PDF.
- Replaced the cryptic "Expecting property name ... (char 2)" failure with a clear message telling the customer admin to re-download the bundle as a file instead of copy-pasting it.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
